title: Handshake
description: Version-negotiation handshake — the first messages exchanged on every new connection (RESEARCH.md Pattern 3). Client emits hello; server validates the major version and replies hello.response before any other traffic. Prevents protocol-drift silent corruption (SC#3 / §Security).
$comment: hello carries the client's declared capabilities (events/requests/...). hello.response carries the server's negotiated version. Major-version mismatch → reject (no hello.response or ok:false) — exercised in Plan 02's handshake unit test. The version pattern matches the envelope's (major.minor).

ok.description: Required on hello.response; absent on hello.

payload.description: hello payload = {capabilities: string[]}; hello.response payload = {serverVersion: string}. Discriminated by type.
